condition_pairs.context: So sanh dac ta DUNG (P) voi hanh vi THAT cua code (Q) tai POST /api/orders (index.js dong 643-720) ve viec xac thuc totalAmount cua don hang.
condition_pairs.note: P (dac ta DUNG): don hang chi duoc chap nhan neu totalAmount = so_luong * gia_that_trong_catalog. Q (code THAT): route chi kiem tra gio hang khong rong (qty>=1) va co day du shippingInfo, KHONG doi chieu totalAmount voi gia that (BUG-06, CWE-602). Z3 se tim phan vi du cu the: mot bo (qty, totalAmount) ma code THAT chap nhan nhung dac ta DUNG se tu choi - chinh la kich ban tan cong 'tu khai gia'.
